mode.title: Mode
mode.description: new_listings = coins listed in the last N days across the selected venues. announcements = OKX listing notices, published before the listing goes live. delistings = scheduled and recent delistings (Bitget publishes the off time).

venues.title: Exchanges
venues.description: Which exchanges to read: okx, gate, bitget, kucoin. All four by default.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How far back the listing window reaches. 7 = everything listed in the last week. Raise it on a quiet week, lower it for a daily scheduled run.

quoteCurrencies.title: Quote currencies
quoteCurrencies.description: Keep only pairs quoted in these currencies. USDT by default, which also keeps one row per coin per venue: a single listing often creates USDT, USD and TRY pairs at once. Clear it to return every pair.

minVolumeUsd.title: Min 24h quote volume
minVolumeUsd.description: Skip pairs trading less than this in 24h. Filters out listings that never got any interest. 0 = no minimum.

includePrices.title: Include live price and 24h move
includePrices.description: Join each listing to the venue's live ticker so rows carry price, 24h change and 24h volume. One extra request per venue.

announcementType.title: Announcement type (announcements mode)
announcementType.description: Which OKX announcement feed to read.

announcementPages.title: Announcement pages (announcements mode)
announcementPages.description: How many pages of announcements to walk back through.

newOnly.title: Only rows not seen before
newOnly.description: Remember what previous runs returned and emit only what is new. Turn this on for a scheduled alert feed so you are not billed for the same listing every run.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
